infrastructure.infraDescription:
Introduction

Indira Institute of Management Pune (IIMP) is a reputed private management institute established in 1994 and located in Tathawade, Pune. It offers full-time PGDM and BBA programs including Healthcare & Hospital Management specialization. The institute has a strong industry interface with collaborations and internships, excellent placement records with top recruiters like Citi Bank, Motilal Oswal, and Manipal Hospitals. It focuses on holistic student development with various programs such as Yoga, Cyber Security awareness, and leadership lectures.
